- **Backup warning contradicts 'nothing to do' on overview** (week 0, landlord): expected 'If 10 of 12 flats lack a backup in 24h, the overview should show it as a task or at least explain it, or show no warning at all'; actual "Overview says 'Letzte Sicherungen 2 / 12, 10 ohne Sicherung unter 24 Stunden' while 'Handlungsbedarf 0' and 'Nichts zu tun – alle 12 Wohnungen sind in Ordnung'. ### security

- **No security issue seen in normal use** (week 4, tenant1): expected 'n/a'; actual "Only my own rooms appear; no other tenant's data, secrets or private keys were visible." -- `http://127.0.0.1:8301/`
- **Apartment ids visible in task and link paths** (week 28, admin): expected 'Apartment ids are opaque or not in links'; actual 'Links expose readable ids such as sim-a05 and sim-a12. This is not a leak by itself, since the admin already sees the apartments, but readable ids in URLs make enumeration trivial' -- `/ui/tasks`
- **Admin-Konto hat keinen Passkey, nur Authenticator-App** (week 32, admin): expected 'Für Administratoren ist ein Passkey als phishing-resistenter Zweitfaktor hinterlegt'; actual "Passkeys: 0 registriert. Zwei-Faktor über Authenticator-App ist aktiv. Das ist kein Fehler, aber der Hinweis 'Verfügbar' lädt nicht zur Einrichtung ein." -- `passkeys.png (/ui/account/webauthn)`
- **None found in normal use** (week 56, tenant1): expected 'n/a'; actual "No other apartment's data or secrets seen in normal use; the tenant view showed only the four rooms of this apartment" -- `http://127.0.0.1:8301/schedule`
- **Passkey page shows no last-used or sign-in-history information** (week 104, admin): expected 'Passkey entries show when each was registered and last used, so I can spot stale or unknown keys.'; actual 'The Konto passkey section has only a count and an empty state. It has no dates, so I cannot check for stale keys.' -- `http://127.0.0.1:8200/ui/account/webauthn`
- **Backup hash shown on the apartment page** (week 115, landlord): expected 'Nothing I need to see; the encrypted backup should be opaque to me'; actual "Backup entries show a truncated 'Hash' with 'Hash kopieren' and 'Entschlüsseln' buttons on the Wartung tab; the hash is truncated, so this is probably fine, but I can't tell what 'Entschlüsseln' would do without a key" -- `/ui/apartments/sim-a10?ansicht=wartung`
- **Interne Kommandozeile in der Fehlermeldung sichtbar** (week 116, admin): expected 'Fehlermeldung nennt nur die Ursache für den Benutzer'; actual "Die Meldung nennt 'python -m agent run' und '--help'. Die Information ist harmlos, verrät aber interne Startparameter." -- `/ui/apartments/sim-a01?ansicht=wartung`
